findings.problem: Three user stories (US-SEC-006, US-SEC-011, US-SEC-012) carry 'Traces: — (scope only)' per the PRD engine's own allowance for stories that serve no single policy, but the machine contract C4.4 requires >=1 POL trace per story and flags all three as MAJOR.
findings.fix: No content change needed for v1 — this is a tension between engine prose (which explicitly permits scope-only stories) and the contract's blanket min-1 rule, not a traceability defect (each story's Source line correctly cites the plan section and, where relevant, the module registry entities it seeds). Track as a factory-level refinement: either loosen C4.4 to accept a 'scope-only' marker, or require scope-only stories to cite the module-registry row they seed instead of a POL id.
